value: ソードアート・オンライン (Sōdo Āto Onrain)
text: The Japanese title is written ソードアート・オンライン in katakana, read Sōdo Āto Onrain.
excerpt: ソードアート・オンライン (Sōdo Āto Onrain)

text: Reki Kawahara writes the Sword Art Online novels and abec draws their illustrations.
excerpt: "Reki Kawahara" wrote the series; "abec" provides illustrations for light novels

text: The light novels began in print on April 10, 2009, under the Dengeki Bunko imprint of ASCII Media Works.
excerpt: April 10, 2009 via ASCII Media Works' Dengeki Bunko imprint

text: As of April 10, 2026, the main light novel series stands at 29 volumes.
excerpt: 29 volumes have been published as of April 10, 2026

text: Before it was a printed series, Kawahara shared the story online as a web novel under the pen name Fumio Kunori.
excerpt: published it as a web novel under the pseudonym Fumio Kunori

text: Kawahara's later work Accel World won the Grand Prize of the Dengeki competition, which led the publisher to ask him to publish Sword Art Online as well.
excerpt: participated in the competition again by writing Accel World, this time winning the Grand Prize

value: A full-dive game with no logout
text: Players of a full-dive virtual reality game discover they cannot log out, and the only way home is to clear the game.
excerpt: unable to log out

text: The NerveGear is a helmet that feeds the five senses to the brain, so players can control their game characters with their minds.
excerpt: a helmet that stimulates the user's five senses via their brain

text: On the first day, 10,000 players enter the game and find they cannot log out.
excerpt: On November 6, 10,000 players log into SAO's mainframe cyberspace for the first time

text: To go free, the players have to beat all 100 floors of the floating castle Aincrad.
excerpt: beat all 100 floors of Aincrad

value: Death in the game means death in life
text: The rule of the game is that a player who dies in it, or who has the NerveGear forcibly removed, dies in real life too.
excerpt: those who suffer in-game deaths or forcibly remove the NerveGear out-of-game will suffer real-life deaths

text: After the game is cleared, 300 players, Asuna among them, are still stuck inside their NerveGear.
excerpt: Kazuto discovers that 300 SAO players, including Asuna, remain trapped in their NerveGear

text: Agil tells Kirito that a figure like Asuna was spotted on the World Tree of the game Alfheim Online.
excerpt: a figure similar to Asuna was spotted on "The World Tree" in another VRMMORPG cyberspace called Alfheim Online

text: In Gun Gale Online, Kirito looks into a string of murders and takes part in a gunfight tournament named Bullet of Bullets.
excerpt: investigate a series of murders involving another VRMMORPG called Gun Gale Online ... Bullet of Bullets (BoB)

text: The Soul Translator lets Kirito enter the Underworld, where the clock runs a thousand times faster than outside.
excerpt: In the UW, the flow of time proceeds a thousand times faster than in the real world
